title: Grateful Dead Live at Fillmore West on 1970-06-05
lineage: MSR> CASS> DAT> CDR> EAC> FLAC and Audience (shnid:109847) Lineage: Source #1: Dire Wolf through New Speedway - unknown gen aud cassette; Source #2: Cold Rain through Mama Tried - unknown gen aud cassette; Source #3: Cryptical through Casey -  unknown gen aud cassette
source: Matrix from Soundboard (shnid:28653) (except where patched with low gen AUD as noted)

ai_review.summary: Clear acoustic vocals and sweet setlist make this recording a solid showcase of the 1970 SF Acoustic Dead run despite a few missing parts.
ai_review.review: The shows captured on this tape feature an especially praised acoustic set – highlighted by a top‑five “I Know You Rider”, sweet Bob Weir harmonies, crystal‑clear Garcia vocals and standout numbers like Black Peter, Easy Wind and Pigpen’s take on It’s A Man’s World.  Recording quality is generally good with the sound improving after Dire Wolf, though listeners note missing Pigpen acoustic parts and Phil’s backing vocals.

ai_rating.rationale: Strong musical performance with many standout songs and clear vocal mix, offset by some missing elements and no explicit source information.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Garcia's voice described as crystal clear, Weir’s vocals sweet; sound improves after Dire Wolf.  No major distortion noted but some acoustic portions (Pigpen, Phil backing) appear missing.

standout_songs: That's It For The Other One > Attics
show_quality.setlist_flow: Acoustic set opens the show with mellow, tightly sung numbers; electric portion runs longer with high‑energy highlights like Easy Wind and Pigpen’s soulful cover, creating a well‑balanced evening.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Garcia's voice is described as crystal clear throughout the acoustic set.
band_member_comments.Phil: Phil's backing vocals are not heard on this recording.
band_member_comments.Bob: Weir's vocal harmonies are praised as sweet and complementary.
